children: Custom Health Holdings Inc. agreed to a best-efforts public offering of units for gross proceeds of up to C$12.0M and intends a concurrent private placement for up to approximately C$10.0M. The offerings are subject to approvals and have not closed.
Public offering: up to C$12.0M gross
The financing would provide capital, but the amount raised is not final and closing remains subject to conditions.
Private placement: up to approximately C$10.0M
Adds potential proceeds beyond the public offering; the amount may differ and closing is expected within 30 days after the offering.
Units priced at C$4.95; one share and warrant
New shares dilute existing holders; warrants could add further shares if exercised.
Warrants exercisable at C$5.90 for 60 months
Potential future dilution depends on warrant exercise; the exercise price is above the unit price.
Proceeds may fund acquisitions and debt repayments
Proceeds are also intended for expenses and working capital; allocation depends on gross proceeds raised.

This is a proposed financing, not a completed raise, and the release cites negative working capital and going-concern uncertainty among its risks. Closing, final proceeds and the concurrent placement's completion are the next milestones, subject to required approvals.
